notes.title: Small Patch - Offline Mode available and Brightness settings.
notes.content:
Hello all you Foglight fans!

[b]Changes:[/b]

Players can now select offline mode from the host menu to play without internet (bots will have to be enabled to start a match). 

Players can now adjust screen gamma brightness from settings. 

[b]Bug fix:[/b]

A bug where players could get stuck in the small windmill on the Lighthouse map is now fixed.

notes.title: 1.45 HUMAN BOTS!!
notes.content:
Hello all you Foglight fans!

A very special update for you today. This is one that many of you have been asking for on the discord. Players can now add Human Bots. 

[b]How Human Bots work:[/b]

Bots can be turned on like Farberto, from the host screen before a match starts. 3 Bots will be spawned when turned on at the human spawn point. Bots can only be turned on if the total number of real life players is below 4. (This will keep the game from going over 1 v 6, which has been tested as an optimal number for gameplay experience with the current map designs).

Human Bots will be able to do everything regular human players can with exception to using the specialty items, aka the Flamethrower and Stun Gun. They will be able to throw flashbangs, scent decoys, traps and flip breakers. Thus players will be able to play a round as Farberto by themselves and get the full experience with a foe trying to escape. This will also allow players to buff up their match if they are having trouble filling a room and of course this is great for practice if you are just learning.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

A large bug as been fixed. A bug where you could sometimes not pickup the Flash bang and other items. 

[b]Map changes[/b]

Those of you with a keen eye will notice a few minor changes in a few of the maps. These changes are small but have been done so in order to accommodate the human bots for smooth gameplay.

notes.title: 1.44 New Map and more!
notes.content:
Hello all you Foglight fans!

This update includes a new map, Hospital. 

Hospital is a fun new map that focuses on tight corridor scares. This new map comes with a new achievement as well. 

Other changes

-Players can now change their camera to a first person view by pressing the P button
-The AI Farberto now has a random spawn spot
-Using steam advanced sessions for voice chat now
-Storage Closets now respawn 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39648918/3bf5f0c18cba0338c74a3fa1b54c223527db7760.png[/img]

Early Release Status:

The game will be moving out of early release soon. If you already have the game you will not have to pay for it.

notes.title: V1.42 Fixed Victory text for Breakers and Quickstart bug
notes.content:
The Quickstart would sometimes crash if it couldnt find a server because it was in a loop. That is fixed.

If you turned on all breakers, but killed Farberto, it would say "escaped" vs what it should say "killed farberto". Now that is fixed.

notes.title: v1.41 Fixing the Fatal Error bug
notes.content:
The Fatal Error bug tends to pop up when the Host makes a new server and changes the map.

The solution was that the game would have to restart, but hopefully now that is no longer the case as the game checks for this error before loading you into the hosts room.

The issue will still be there if connecting to people on older versions so make sure you have 1.41 or above if reading this.

notes.title: V. 1.4 Game File Size has been optimized
notes.content:
Hello all you Foglight fans.

Efforts have been made to reduce the size of the overall game. By removing unused high res textures and models, the game size has been reduced by about 40%. I hope this will encourage more downloads and result in smoother gameplay. [b]UNINSTAL THE GAME AND RE-INSTALL[/b]. Once done you will have the new smaller game that is around 10 gigs. (If you just download it without re-installing, it will just copy over the files and not remove the extra ones).

A few minor tweaks have also been changed. 

-Farberto would die if he used his roar attach near the Graveyard spike pits. The collision detection from the shockwave was interfering with the hit detection of the spikes, dealing damage to him. That has been fixed. 

-Some text changes have been made on the UI as well. When games end, the text will state why players got the ending they got. For example, [i]Humans win, players have escaped.[/i]

-A Green Spotlight now appears above the exit to help players find their way back to the exit gate once all the breakers are flipped. 

-The Fog has been adjusted so players on lower settings can see better.

notes.title: Small patch adjustments based on community feedback
notes.content:
Hi Foglight Fans!

Changes:

Graveyard Map Day/Night cycle removed. Just stays Night now. Added more Fog. 

Farberto AI tweaked to be a bit more smooth.

Minor map changes in regards to moving some objects around.

Items respawn 90 seconds now vs 30

Minor UI changes

notes.title: UPDATE: NEW MAP AND A.I.
notes.content:
Hello all you Foglight fans out there, a big new update for you.

NEW MAP: GRAVEYARD

Filled with the victims of Farberto, the Graveyard is the best looking map yet! Farberto has terrorized the local small town of Stone Hill, filling its cemetery with bodies. A small group of of ruffians gets together to put an end to Farbertos terror! Watch out for in map booby traps in this mid sized action packed expansion. [img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/801641207989010512/809237350902530068/screenshot_graveyard2.png[/img]

New changes

AI BOT for Farberto.
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/801641207989010512/810026923576393728/AI.png[/img]
Players can now play with an A.I. controlled Farberto. The A.I. will have all the abilities of the human controlled Farberto, but make no mistake that this A.I. is hyper aggressive! You can turn on A.I. when a lobby room is created and all players will be made human.

How Items work with the AI.

The Bear Trap works the same as it did before. Toss it down and he will get stuck for a short time.

The Flash Bang will scare the A.I. away. The A.I. will run off for a bit,  before coming back, if a Flash Bang is tossed in his face.

The Scented Bottles are probably the best weapon vs the A.I. The A.I. will always go towards a Scented Bottle when thrown, so use them often. 

How the A.I. works. 

The A.I. spawns and will randomly wander the map, eventually he will get the scent of the players and wonder in their direction. Finally once a player is in visual range, the A.I. will go hyper aggressive. If you hear his roar, you are probably dead... 

Stay alive a little longer and your day might get brighter!
That is all for now, enjoy!

notes.title: Minor bugs, spectating, and more
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed
-Spectate Camera fixed (no more cat feet)
-Spawning multiple Farbers in a match is fixed

Changes
When players get to the exit, the match won't end until all players escape. However, humans still win if even one player escapes.

notes.title: UPDATE: NEW WEAPON AND ABILITY
notes.content:
Hello all you monster and monster hunters out there!
The following changes have been added to Foglight Online.

[b]Stun Gun[/b]

Each map will now have a Stun Gun that can be found. Similar to the Flamethrower, the Stun Gun requires another part to be found in order to work. Once assembled the Stun Gun will be a powerful tool for the human players. It can stop Farberto in his tracks from a long distance, and deals decent damage. Working in a team with one player having a Stun Gun and One player having a Flamethrower will allow new strategies - where the Stun Gun player can hold Farberto in place and the Flamer can fire him. The Stun Gun is a limited use Weapon with 5 shots per player. If one player is killed and drops the Stun Gun the next player can pick it up with 5 fresh shots. The Stun Gun comes with a new Steam achievement.

[b]Shock Wave[/b]

Fear not Farberto fans, for he is also getting a treat this update! Farber has a new attack. His Roar attack, which before was nothing more then a taunt, now unleashes a powerful Shock Wave! This is an area of effect attack. Any player that is close to Farberto when he throws down the Shock Wave will get hit hard. There was several comments from the community in regards to Farberto needing a buff and hopefully this will make him truly a threat.

[i]Small Tweaks[/i]

Flamethrower buff. The Flamethrower damage has been raised significantly.

Farbertos heal ability is paused while he is on fire.

Lobby timer has been increased to 120 seconds.

Humans give off larger scent signatures now.

Pesky map display bug has been addressed (again).

Some small hud changes.

That is all for now. Until next time, happy hunting!

notes.title: Small bug tweak
notes.content: Several small issues were addressed. One of the human player models was still having issues with the breaker. That is now fixed. Farberto also doesn't get automatic wins now if he leaves mid game.
